scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix be install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n be,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix be run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.dev:legacy-fe: concurrently -n be,fe -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix be run dev" "npm --prefix fe run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix be run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix be test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
